metadata.datasource: Synthetic neutral B&W print; no branded paper measurements
metadata.derivation: Andrea Volpato's CC BY-SA profile container; colour dye data completely replaced. Digitized manufacturer plots, approximate relative sensitivity, neutral optical density, synthetic CDF sublayers, shoulder and grain priors. NOT a calibrated film or paper reproduction.
metadata.sensitivity_interpretation: Published ILFORD/FOMA relative chart values treated as linear; Kodak as log10. Spectrogram light-source effects are not inverted; absolute ISO is not recovered. Film response is normalized to the existing daylight/green exposure convention.
